statement_fetch_source:
from pathlib import Path
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
from urllib.parse import urljoin
from datetime import datetime
import requests,json,hashlib,time
d=Path('reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1');out=d/'sources'
protocol=json.loads((d/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
s=BeautifulSoup((out/'官方按年声明目录.html').read_bytes(),'html.parser')
routes=[];year=None
for tr in s.select('tr'):
 header=tr.find('th',id=True)
 if header and header['id'].isdigit():year=int(header['id'])
 if year not in [2022,2023,2024,2025]:continue
 for a in tr.select('a[href]'):
  text=a.get_text(' ',strip=True).replace('\u200b','').strip()
  routes.append({'year':year,'quarter':int(text[0]),'catalog_text':text,'url':urljoin(protocol['source_scope']['catalog_url'],a['href'])})
assert len(routes)==16 and len({(r['year'],r['quarter']) for r in routes})==16
routes.sort(key=lambda r:(r['year'],r['quarter']))
(d/'registered_source_routes.json').write_text(json.dumps(routes,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
def fetch(route):
 p=out/f"{route['year']}Q{route['quarter']}_政策声明.html"
 attempts=[]
 if route['year']==2023 and route['quarter']==4:
  old=Path('reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1/sources/20231101财政部季度安排.html')
  raw=old.read_bytes();p.write_bytes(raw)
  rec={**route,'local_file':p.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw),'status':'REUSED','original_file':str(old)}
 else:
  for attempt in range(1,3):
   try:
    r=requests.get(route['url'],timeout=40)
    attempts.append({'attempt':attempt,'http_status':r.status_code})
    if r.status_code in [403,429]:break
    r.raise_for_status()
    raw=r.content;p.write_bytes(raw)
    rec={**route,'local_file':p.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw),'status':'FETCHED','http_status':r.status_code,'retrieved_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'attempts':attempts}
    break
   except requests.RequestException as e:
    attempts[-1:] = attempts[-1:] or [{'attempt':attempt}]
    attempts[-1]['error']=str(e)
  else:rec=None
  if 'raw' not in locals():return {**route,'status':'FAILED','attempts':attempts}
 soup=BeautifulSoup(raw,'html.parser')
 tables=[t.get_text(' ',strip=True)[:1800] for t in soup.find_all('table')]
 imgs=[{'src':im.get('src'),'alt':im.get('alt')} for im in soup.select('img[src]') if not any(x in im['src'].lower() for x in ['logo','icon','banner','flags','seal'])]
 date_candidates=[x.get_text(' ',strip=True) for x in soup.find_all(['time','span','div']) if any('date' in c.lower() for c in x.get('class',[])) and len(x.get_text(' ',strip=True))<130]
 rec['table_summaries']=tables;rec['image_candidates']=imgs;rec['date_candidates']=date_candidates
 print(json.dumps({'年度季度':f"{route['year']}Q{route['quarter']}",'状态':rec['status'],'正文日期':date_candidates,'表数':len(tables),'图片':imgs},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
 return rec
records=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
 futures=[pool.submit(fetch,r) for r in routes]
 for f in as_completed(futures):records.append(f.result())
records.sort(key=lambda r:(r['year'],r['quarter']))
(d/'statement_source_receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('已保存16条固定来源回执；成功数：'+str(sum(r['status']!='FAILED' for r in records)),flush=True)
